title: Mini-concerts
intro1: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Concert Hall is to undergo renovation for around two years. During this time, the Brandenburg State Orchestra will be based at the exhibition halls on the outskirts of the city – a long way from the city centre.
intro2: To ensure that BSOF remains visible and accessible, the Förderverein also supports formats such as **mini-concerts in the city centre**. Small ensembles, great music – right in the heart of Frankfurt (Oder), where people go about their daily lives.
orte_intro: The places vary – wherever life takes place:
orte:
Care homes
Nurseries
Hospice
Rosengarten Wildlife Park Frankfurt (Oder)
infobox: **Support from Förderverein and BSOF:** Förderverein helps to ensure that mini-concerts can be organised and held in the city centre. Your membership helps to safeguard this presence in the city.
mitmachen: Become a member and help ensure that Frankfurt (Oder) doesn’t have to go without its music during the refurbishment phase – both in the exhibition halls and in the city centre.
